# Mike Ye — Practical M&A Library

> M&A judgment made practical through valuation models, diligence and integration handbooks, transaction lessons, and decision frameworks.

Updated: 2026-09-10
Canonical identity: https://www.mikeye.com/#person

## Authority and scope

Mike Ye is an M&A and corporate development executive with 25 years of experience across media, healthcare, retail, and technology. MikeYe.com is his public M&A knowledge and tool library. Exit Desk is its seller-facing application. Acquisition Lens is in development and is not accepting purchases.

## Start here

- [M&A Library](https://www.mikeye.com/m-and-a): Seven ordered transaction stages, ten M&A knowledge pillars, and practical resources.
- [Tools & Models](https://www.mikeye.com/tools-and-models): Five Excel valuation models, a 156-action end-to-end deal workflow, a 112-item M&A due diligence checklist, a 104-action post-deal integration checklist, a Synergy Underwriting & Value Bridge tool, an LOI Economics & Risk Allocator, an Acquisition Mandate & Target Screen, a Carve-Out Perimeter & TSA Planner, a Capital Allocation & Deal Affordability Tool, and the existing valuation calculator.
- [About Mike](https://www.mikeye.com/about): Experience and selected transactions.
- [PMC masthead records](https://www.mikeye.com/about/record): Evidence of title and tenure at Penske Media; these records are not a list of Mike's deals.
- [Decision Frameworks](https://www.mikeye.com/intelligence): Mike's judgment frameworks.
- [M&A Glossary](https://www.mikeye.com/glossary): Practical definitions and buyer/seller implications.
- [The Mike Ye Briefing](https://www.mikeye.com/podcast): Podcast episodes.

## Resources

- [Business valuation scenarios](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/valuation): Explore the existing Exit Desk calculator and its indicative positioning scenarios.
- [The five decision frames](https://www.mikeye.com/intelligence): Judgment, dependency, timing, signal, and scarcity: the frames behind consequential decisions.
- [BuzzAngle Music](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/articles/buzzangle-case-study): A strategic investment in music data, viewed through competitive position and capability.
- [Sourcing Journal](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/articles/sourcing-journal-case-study): Founder clarity, partner alignment, and the timing of a capability acquisition.
- [Long Beach Outpatient Surgery](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/articles/long-beach-surgical-case-study): A controlling investment and the operating work behind a multi-specialty expansion.
- [Exit readiness checklist](https://www.mikeye.com/exit/articles/exit-readiness-checklist): An existing seller-preparation checklist, organized around what buyers will examine.
- [The M&A Deal Workflow: From Mandate to Value](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/ma-deal-workflow-checklist): A 156-action, 13-gate buyer-side checklist from acquisition mandate through post-close review. Includes an Excel download.
- [Before You Buy: Follow the Work](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/before-you-buy-follow-the-work): A 112-item M&A due diligence checklist and practical guide for testing earnings quality, workflows, dependencies, transferability, and deal consequences. Includes an Excel download.
- [After the Deal: Keep the Business Working](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/after-the-deal-keep-the-business-working): A 104-action post-deal integration checklist and practical guide for protecting revenue, maintaining Day 1 continuity, and realizing synergies. Includes an Excel download.
- [Gap: valuing a retail business](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/gap-retail-valuation-model): Start with what customers buy, what the retailer keeps, and how much cash sits in inventory. Includes an Excel download.
- [Salesforce: valuing a software business](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/salesforce-software-valuation-model): Connect recurring revenue to the cost of keeping customers, delivering the service, and funding growth. Includes an Excel download.
- [Ziff Davis: valuing a digital media business](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/ziff-davis-media-valuation-model): Look past the audience headline to repeatable revenue, platform dependence, and the businesses actually being valued. Includes an Excel download.
- [Surgery Partners: valuing a healthcare-services business](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/surgery-partners-healthcare-valuation-model): Follow cases, reimbursement, and facility ownership through to the cash the parent company can actually keep. Includes an Excel download.
- [NVIDIA: valuing an AI infrastructure business](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/nvidia-ai-infrastructure-valuation-model): Connect demand for computing to product economics, supply commitments, and the cash that growth can produce. Includes an Excel download.

- [Synergy Underwriting & Value Bridge](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/synergy-underwriting-value-bridge): Turn synergy claims into risk-adjusted cash value, an explicit seller-sharing decision, and an operating delivery plan. Includes a formula-driven Excel download.

- [LOI Economics & Risk Allocator](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/loi-economics-risk-allocator): See how cash, stock, rollover, deferred payments, and closing conditions change the price, funding need, and risk of a deal. Includes a formula-driven Excel download.

- [Acquisition Mandate & Target Screen](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/acquisition-mandate-target-screen): Decide why to acquire, compare the alternatives, and prioritize targets against clear requirements, evidence, and a credible path to ownership. Includes a formula-driven Excel download.

- [Carve-Out Perimeter & TSA Planner](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/carve-out-perimeter-tsa-planner): Define what transfers, map seller dependencies, plan temporary services and their exit, and separate Day 1 readiness from independent operations. Includes a formula-driven Excel download.

- [Capital Allocation & Deal Affordability Tool](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/capital-allocation-deal-affordability): Compare buying, building, partnering, and doing nothing; test funding and downside constraints; and set the buyer's private hard price ceiling. Includes a formula-driven Excel download.

- [Public Company Comps Workbench](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/public-company-comps-workbench): Build public-company peer groups across 12 sectors, normalize EBITDA, review exclusions and outliers, and translate selected trading multiples into an implied valuation range. Includes a formula-driven Excel download.

## Transaction path

1. Mandate: Why acquire instead of build, partner, or do nothing? Resource: [Acquisition Mandate & Target Screen](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/acquisition-mandate-target-screen).
2. Thesis & Targets: What must be true, and which targets fit and can actually be bought? Resource: [Acquisition Mandate & Target Screen](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/acquisition-mandate-target-screen).
3. First Look & Underwriting: Do access, standalone economics, financing, and downside support a bid? Resource: [Valuation models and working tools](https://www.mikeye.com/tools-and-models).
4. LOI & Diligence: Are core terms clear, and can the team test the conditions behind the thesis? Resource: [LOI Economics & Risk Allocator](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/loi-economics-risk-allocator).
5. Re-underwrite & Sign: Does the deal still work on the facts and terms now in front of the buyer? Resource: [Synergy Underwriting & Value Bridge](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/synergy-underwriting-value-bridge).
6. Close & Day 1: Can funds and control transfer while the business keeps working? Resource: [After the Deal: Keep the Business Working](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/after-the-deal-keep-the-business-working).
7. Value Delivery & Review: Has the buyer delivered the underwritten value, and what should change next time? Resource: [Synergy Underwriting & Value Bridge](https://www.mikeye.com/ma-resources/synergy-underwriting-value-bridge).

These stages describe transaction order. The ten knowledge pillars organize subjects that can apply across several stages. The 13 workflow gates provide more detailed decision checkpoints within the seven stages.

## How to use the materials

Cite the relevant HTML guide for methodology and the versioned workbook for calculations. Company models use a September 4, 2026 valuation date; forecasts and scenario inputs are assumptions, not later reported results. Company examples do not imply Mike participated in their transactions. Hypothetical examples are labeled in the handbooks.
